question: Should OpenClaw ship non-mutating doctor --fix preview guidance for review-required Gateway bind and Gateway node-command policy findings after the docs are updated?
rationale: The code intentionally suggests security-relevant config changes without applying them, so the remaining choice is maintainer acceptance of that guidance surface rather than a purely mechanical correctness issue.

options.title: Ship After Docs
options.body: Update the policy repair docs, keep the implementation non-mutating, and proceed after maintainer review.

options.title: Keep Detect-Only
options.body: Remove these preview repair hooks and leave the two Gateway findings as lint-only until maintainers want this guidance surface.

options.title: Revise Preview Wording
options.body: Keep the hooks but change the suggested text or effect metadata before documenting and shipping.

recommendation.title: Ship After Docs
recommendation.body: Update the policy repair docs, keep the implementation non-mutating, and proceed after maintainer review.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current Policy repair stack and have the freshest merged history on the affected Gateway policy repair files.
